title: Anonymized issue-collection k-anon differential oracle
description: Proves the implementation's k-anon issue aggregate (bin/lib/cp_issue_aggregate.py) matches an INDEPENDENTLY-authored reference aggregator (reference/aggregate_ref.py) over identical seeded issue_v1 streams. Both sides are normalized to a common comparable partition — the served bucket set + the suppressed bucket set + the security-exclusion count — and diffed. The impl author (Waves 1-3) and the reference author (Wave 2d) are disjoint; this gate harness (Wave 4) is authored by neither, wiring the diff so oracle independence holds by construction.

load_bearing.INV-B: a signature bucket is SERVED only at >= ISSUE_K_ANONYMITY_MIN (=10) DISTINCT team_id_hash; sub-threshold buckets are SUPPRESSED (teams-only marker, never metrics). Distinct-team count, never row count.
load_bearing.INV-F: a security_sensitive record NEVER enters the public aggregate, at any team count; it is excluded and counted opaquely.
load_bearing.INV-G: the partition counts DISTINCT teams and never emits a per-team row (tenant isolation preserved in the output shape).

reference.no_impl_import: reference/aggregate_ref.py imports nothing from bin/lib/* — every constant and computation is reproduced from INVARIANTS.md alone (enforced by grep acceptance).

normalization.why: impl and reference legitimately use different envelopes (issue_aggregate_v1 dimensions map vs issue_aggregate_ref_v1 served/suppressed lists), so the raw envelopes are NOT byte-diffed. Both are projected to the same partition before diffing (reference/README §'Aggregate output wrapper shape').
